image_details.photo_context: Unremarkable candid photo taken on an older smartphone by a family member standing in the kitchen doorway. Never edited, no filter. The kind of ordinary photo that sits unnoticed in a camera roll or runs beside a local newspaper health article.

subject.demographics: Woman in her late 40s, ordinary and believable, medium build
subject.features: Real mature skin with visible texture and faint lines, tired eyes with under-eye shadows, no makeup, slightly uneven skin tone
subject.hair: Shoulder-length dark blonde going grey at the part, pulled back carelessly, flyaways
subject.expression: Flat and foggy, eyes unfocused, staring at nothing past her coffee. Not crying, not performing sadness, just switched off
subject.pose: Sitting at the kitchen table, slumped, head propped on one hand with fingers in her hair at the temple. She does not know a photo is being taken

attire.upper_body: Rumpled oatmeal cardigan over an old heather grey t-shirt

image_details.action: Sitting alone at the breakfast table on a grey weekday morning, coffee gone cold in front of her, too drained to start the day

environment.location: Ordinary lived-in kitchen, lights off, only dim window light
environment.foreground: A little too much empty table at the bottom of the frame

background.left: Kitchen window, slightly blown out and overexposed
background.right: Counter with last night's unwashed dishes and a cereal box left out, older cabinetry
background.clutter: Fridge with mismatched magnets, dish towel hanging off the oven handle, nothing arranged for the camera

on_table: Full mug of coffee gone cold
Stray charging cable partly cut off by the edge of the frame

technical_style.lighting: Dim grey overcast window light, mixed white balance between the bright window and the darker interior, mild noise in the shadows
technical_style.composition: Shot from across the kitchen at eye level, framing slightly tilted and a bit too wide, subject off to the left, background only mildly soft, no studio bokeh
technical_style.quality: Honest and a bit dull, flat muted colors, zero retouching, no glow, no HDR, boring realism
